patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...). Inside that directory, there will be a folder named 'game'. Download the patch archive from the link below Extract the patch archive into the 'game' folder mentioned above, overwriting files when prompted It's working if: After the Argent Games logo, there is a warning splash screen about the adult content.
